ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Credential Dumping Via WER
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential credential dumping via Windows Error Reporting LSASS Shtinkering technique which uses the Windows Error Reporting to dump lsass

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\Werfault\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "WerFault\.exe") AND ((parent_process_user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR parent_process_user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*")) AND (user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ \\-p\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ip\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ .*")))) AND  NOT (parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\lsass\.exe")
